text: In the small town of Devil's Kettle, Minnesota, bookish Needy has always lived in the shadow of her beautiful best friend Jennifer. After a fire tears through a dive bar, Jennifer leaves with an indie band who [offer her to Satan in exchange for fame|wrong|human sacrifice], and she comes back [vomiting black fluid in Needy's kitchen|threat|being taken over]. Now she [seduces the boys of her school and devours them|rules|it must feed], and Needy, searching the library's occult shelves, learns she can only die [while she is hungry and weak|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
